_comment: 4 side-by-side zones (1 ft each) along the shelf, one antenna per zone at the AISLE edge, centered on its zone, facing in (toward the back wall) at 45 deg. Ports 1-4 = zones 1-4, left to right seen from the aisle. Origin = front-left corner of the shelf floor (aisle side); x = along the shelf (left -> right), y = depth (aisle -> back wall), z = up. Inches. MEASURE: depth_in, antenna x/z, reference tag position.

reference_tag._comment: On-metal tag on the back wall. Never move it. Ideally centered (x = 24) so all 4 antennas read it.
